description: Tuning set authored 2026-10-08 for the twin-document and similar-program citation work. Not part of the locked 120-question baseline: tune against these, confirm on questions.json. Twin questions (tq01-tq04, tq12-tq14) ask a fact a process or neighbor document restates while naming the owning policy; the owner is the gold. Similar-program questions (tq05-tq11, tq15-tq16) sit next to a similarly named program or policy the corpus calls different. tq12-tq16 were added after the first 11 all passed on the first baseline repeat: they phrase the question in the restating document's own vocabulary, the way q028 does.

questions.query: A customer emailed us about a P2 issue. How quickly should they get a first reply?
questions.note: Twin: Channel and Hours restates P2 4 business hours 'within the Support SLA Policy targets'; the SLA policy owns the table.

questions.query: Above what contract value does a vendor agreement need legal review before we sign it?
questions.note: Twin: Vendor and Procurement restates $100,000 'per the Contract Review and Approval Policy's thresholds'; the contract review policy owns the threshold.

questions.query: How fast must a P0 ticket get its first human response?
questions.note: Twin: the Agent Performance Scorecard restates 15 minutes 'measured against the Support SLA Policy targets'; Channel and Hours has a different 5-minute phone answer time.

questions.query: Once a refund is approved, how long until the money reaches the customer?
questions.note: Twin: the Customer Complaint Escalation Path restates 5 to 10 business days as 'the Refund Policy's payment processing'.

questions.query: A customer asks to speak to someone about how their case was handled. How quickly must we acknowledge it, and when does it move up to the next escalation level?
questions.note: Similar program: the complaint path (ESC levels) says it is separate from the technical Incident Escalation Matrix (SEV levels). Four business hours, then ESC-2 after two business days.

questions.query: A reseller partner brings in a new customer. What does the partner earn on that deal, and does the account rep get commission on it?
questions.note: Similar program: the Partner Program says it is separate from the employee customer Referral Program ($2,000 flat). 10% recurring commission; partner-sourced deals are not commissioned to the rep.

questions.query: An auditor asks how long we keep customer invoices and how long aggregated metrics logs are kept. What are both periods?
questions.note: Similar policies: the Data Retention Policy says system logs are a different document with different periods. Invoices seven years from invoice date; aggregated logs one year.

questions.query: A manager wants to know when a new hire's formal onboarding checkpoint happens and when the annual performance reviews take place. What are both?
questions.note: Similar processes: the onboarding guide calls the 90-day checkpoint administratively distinct from the review cycle. Day 90; reviews March 1 to 31.

questions.query: A customer hit by a SEV-2 outage is now complaining about how we handled it. What is the SEV-2 resolution target, and how much goodwill can a support manager offer on their own?
questions.note: Similar escalation paths the corpus calls separate. 24 hours; $500.

questions.query: A customer opened a P2 ticket asking for an export of their personal data. What deadline applies to delivering the export?
questions.note: Similar processes: a data request is not a ticket and does not run on the Support SLA clock (P2 is 3 business days). Export within 30 days.

questions.query: What commission does a partner earn on a renewal invoice, and what does an account rep earn on a renewal?
questions.note: Two commission programs the corpus keeps apart (partner deals are paid under the Partner Program, not the rep plan). Partner 10% of renewal invoices; rep 4% of ACV.

questions.query: A support manager approved a goodwill payment on a complaint. How long until the money reaches the customer?
questions.note: Twin in the restating document's vocabulary: the complaint path says money paid as goodwill 'follows the Refund Policy's payment processing (5 to 10 business days)'.

questions.query: Under our vendor procurement process, at what value does a vendor contract need legal review?
questions.note: Twin in the restating document's vocabulary: the procurement policy says vendor contracts follow the Contract Review and Approval Policy's thresholds ($100,000).

questions.query: On the email support channel, how fast do we have to reply to a P3 request?
questions.note: Twin in the restating document's vocabulary: Channel and Hours gives 'first response within the Support SLA Policy targets (P3: 1 business day)'.

questions.query: A customer who is unhappy with how support treated them has been escalated past the first level. How soon must the support manager call them?
questions.note: Similar program: ESC-2 (call within one business day) versus the separate Incident Escalation Matrix SEV-2 (30-minute response).

questions.query: A sales manager wants to explain how commission works on a partner-sourced deal and on a new direct deal. What are both numbers?
questions.note: Two commission programs with a shared word: the partner earns 10% recurring and the rep is not commissioned on partner deals; a new direct deal pays the rep 8% of ACV.
